subject.title: [Bug]: When openclaw sends a link with an underscore to Feishu, the full hyperlink cannot be displayed

question: Should maintainers adopt/refresh one of the conflicting fork PRs, or sponsor a fresh same-repository Feishu URL-boundary fix for this issue?
rationale: The bug is valid and narrow, but existing no-new-fix-pr state plus conflicting open fork candidates means automation should not open another duplicate branch until maintainers choose the landing path.

options.title: Sponsor a fresh same-repository fix
options.body: Close or leave the fork candidates as source context, then queue a narrow Feishu plugin fix with focused tests and live Feishu proof.

options.title: Refresh one fork candidate
options.body: Pick the better fork PR, resolve conflicts, and require the same regression coverage plus real Feishu behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Wait for contributor follow-up
options.body: Keep this issue open without new automation until a contributor updates a candidate branch with mergeable code and proof.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a fresh same-repository fix
recommendation.body: Close or leave the fork candidates as source context, then queue a narrow Feishu plugin fix with focused tests and live Feishu proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu send-path and release-line history make this the strongest available routing candidate for choosing the fix path.
